description: Product Concept Design domain — form direction, material direction, CMF, feature/label placement, mockup composition, concept variants, manufacturer brief.
scopeBoundary: Concept-stage design only. This domain does NOT provide engineering drawings, safety certifications, regulatory approvals, or manufacturing-ready CAD specifications. Any client-facing output must carry the CONCEPT_DISCLAIMER string.

routesToMount.note: After mounting, call integration hooks below to wire DB and real ports.

integrationHooks.note: Swap in-memory store for a DB-backed Map or repository implementation.
Required for /mockups and /manufacturer routes to look up concepts by id.
Same resolver pattern as setConceptResolver — wire the same function.
Inject real BlueprintPort and CompositionPort. Until wired, NullBlueprintPort + NullCompositionPort are used (no rendering occurs).

pagesToRegister.note: Customer-facing read-only concept viewer. Register in customer portal router.
Admin concept management panel. Register in ai-platform admin router.

sidebarItems.label: Concept Manager
sidebarItems.note: Admin sidebar entry for product concept management.

sidebarItems.label: Product Concepts
sidebarItems.note: Customer portal sidebar entry — show only when concepts exist for the project.

migrationDrafts.runCommand: DO NOT run directly — review with Team 24, run in transaction with ROLLBACK test.

eventsPublished.note: Emitted after a concept is successfully created.
Emitted after a concept is updated (version bumped).
Emitted when a concept is soft-archived.
Emitted after mockup composition (whether or not render was requested).
Emitted after a variant passes consistency check and is saved.
Emitted after a manufacturer brief is successfully generated.

portAdaptersRequired.note: Generates ordered MockupLayer stacks from a ProductConcept. Real adapter connects to the blueprint rendering service.
Renders a finalised CompositionSpec to object storage. Real adapter connects to the image/SVG rendering pipeline.

knownRisks.risk: In-memory stores reset on server restart
knownRisks.mitigation: Wire DB-backed stores via setConceptStore() and setConceptResolver() integration hooks.

knownRisks.risk: Null ports do not produce real rendered images
knownRisks.mitigation: Wire real BlueprintPort and CompositionPort via setPortRegistry() before going to production.
All output objects carry disclaimer field. assertDisclaimerPresent() is available for enforcement. Never strip disclaimer before client delivery.

knownRisks.risk: Unsupported manufacturing claims in free-text fields
knownRisks.mitigation: guardAgainstUnsupportedClaims() is called on all free-text inputs in routes and brief builder. UNSUPPORTED_MANUFACTURING_CLAIMS list is maintained in manufacturer.ts.
